description:
A powerful political heir and a corporate heiress meet on a blind date arranged in her sister’s place. Pressured to win his favor, she tries to stay composed, only for him to boldly suggest taking things to bed. Mocked all her life as “defective,” she refuses to back down determined to prove exactly what this so-called flaw can claim once desire and ambition collide.
